_comment: Ordered list of images for the Grads gallery (renamed from High-School Seniors 2026-09-07 to also cover college grads — see REQUIREMENTS_CHANGELOG_v1.7.md). Order matters — the first image leads the page. Files live in public/images/grads/. Alt text says 'graduate' rather than 'high-school senior' throughout so it reads correctly for both audiences.

_selectionGuidance: Aim for a spread that speaks to both audiences: personality-driven, model-like frames a grad would choose, and timeless portraits a parent or the grad's own family would want. Include at least one with something meaningful to them — a sport, an instrument, a uniform — and, given the category now covers college grads too, keep at least one or two literal graduation-moment images (cap, gown, degree) in rotation so the page visually explains the rename.
_excluded: From the 45-image batch in Website Gallery Pics/Grads/Grads.zip (2026-09-07): several near-duplicate frames from the same sessions (kept the strongest of each pair), one frame ambiguous about what the subject was holding (erred cautious), and roughly half the batch simply not needed once 20 were selected with good variety — plenty left to draw from later if a swap is ever wanted.
